annotations.title: Preview a LinkedIn ad + its review status

description: See a LinkedIn ad exactly as LinkedIn renders it: desktop and mobile feed preview links straight from LinkedIn (they expire after ~3 hours — ask again for fresh ones), plus the ad’s REVIEW status and, if LinkedIn rejected it, its rejection reasons and serving holds. Works for single-image, carousel, video, job and event ads; LinkedIn’s Ad Preview API renders none for text-only or document ads, and the reply says so. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: LinkedIn ad account id shared with this profile; needed only when several are shared

creativeId.description: ad creative id, from list_linkedin_ads_campaigns or create_linkedin_ads_creative
